title: Memory safety bug fixed in Thunderbird 152
description: A memory safety bug identified as CVE-2026-12298 was fixed in Thunderbird 152. The vulnerability is related to a memory safety issue classified under CWE-125. No CVSS score or detailed impact information is provided. There is no indication of known exploitation in the wild. The affected version explicitly stated is version 4.0 of the Microsoft product referenced, though the title mentions Thunderbird 152, suggesting some ambiguity in product naming.
